=== logs/minimal
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/services
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket AND service IN @services
  where: WHERE 1=1
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @services = []string []string{"api", "web"}
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/excludeServices
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket AND service NOT IN @excServices
  where: WHERE 1=1
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @excServices = []string []string{"noisy"}
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7

=== logs/severities
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND upper(severity_text) IN @severities
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @severities = []string []string{"ERROR", "WARN"}
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/excludeSeverities
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND upper(severity_text) NOT IN @excSeverities
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @excSeverities = []string []string{"DEBUG"}
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/traceID
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND trace_id = @traceID
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7
    @traceID = string "abc123"


=== logs/spanID
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND span_id = @spanID
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @spanID = string "def456"
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/search
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND lowerUTF8(body) LIKE @search
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @search = string "%timeout%"
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/searchEscaping
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND lowerUTF8(body) LIKE @search
  args:
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @search = string "%50\\% off\\_now\\\\x%"
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/attr/empty/string
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND attributes_string[@akey_0] = @aval_0
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "k"
    @aval_0 = string "gateway"
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/attr/empty/numeric
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND (attributes_string[@akey_0] = @aval_0 OR (mapContains(attributes_number, @akey_0) AND attributes_number[@akey_0] = @aval_0_n))
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "k"
    @aval_0 = string "42"
    @aval_0_n = float64 42
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/attr/empty/bool
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND (attributes_string[@akey_0] = @aval_0 OR (mapContains(attributes_bool, @akey_0) AND attributes_bool[@akey_0] = @aval_0_b))
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "k"
    @aval_0 = string "true"
    @aval_0_b = bool true
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec

=== logs/attr/gt/string
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND coalesce(toFloat64OrNull(attributes_string[@akey_0]), if(mapContains(attributes_number, @akey_0), attributes_number[@akey_0], NULL)) > @aval_0
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "k"
    @aval_0 = float64 0
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec

=== logs/attr/multiple
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND (attributes_string[@akey_0] = @aval_0 OR (mapContains(attributes_number, @akey_0) AND attributes_number[@akey_0] = @aval_0_n)) AND positionCaseInsensitive(attributes_string[@akey_1], @aval_1) > 0 AND NOT (mapContains(attributes_string, @akey_2) OR mapContains(attributes_number, @akey_2) OR mapContains(attributes_bool, @akey_2))
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "a"
    @akey_1 = string "b"
    @akey_2 = string "c"
    @aval_0 = string "1"
    @aval_0_n = float64 1
    @aval_1 = string "x"
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7


=== logs/all
  prewhere: PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND ts_bucket BETWEEN @startBucket AND @endBucket AND service IN @services AND service NOT IN @excServices AND host IN @hosts AND host NOT IN @excHosts AND pod IN @pods AND container IN @containers AND environment IN @environments
  where: WHERE 1=1 AND upper(severity_text) IN @severities AND upper(severity_text) NOT IN @excSeverities AND trace_id = @traceID AND span_id = @spanID AND lowerUTF8(body) LIKE @search AND coalesce(toFloat64OrNull(attributes_string[@akey_0]), if(mapContains(attributes_number, @akey_0), attributes_number[@akey_0], NULL)) >= @aval_0
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "a"
    @aval_0 = float64 3
    @containers = []string []string{"c1"}
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @endBucket = uint32 0x695743ec
    @environments = []string []string{"prod"}
    @excHosts = []string []string{"h2"}
    @excServices = []string []string{"noisy"}
    @excSeverities = []string []string{"DEBUG"}
    @hosts = []string []string{"h1"}
    @pods = []string []string{"p1"}
    @search = string "%50\\% off\\_now\\\\x%"
    @services = []string []string{"api", "web"}
    @severities = []string []string{"ERROR", "WARN"}
    @spanID = string "def456"
    @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
    @startBucket = uint32 0x695727cc
    @tenantID = uint32 0x7
    @traceID = string "abc123"

=== traces/all
  resource: AND service IN @services
  span: AND environment IN @environments AND name IN @operations AND kind_string IN @spanKinds AND http_method IN @httpMethods AND response_status_code IN @httpStatuses AND status_code_string IN @statuses AND peer_service IN @peerServices AND positionCaseInsensitive(name, @search) > 0 AND toFloat64OrNull(attributes[@akey_0]) < @aval_0
  root: AND service IN @services AND service NOT IN @excServices AND status_code_string NOT IN @excStatuses AND trace_id = @traceID AND duration_nano >= @minDur AND duration_nano <= @maxDur AND has_error = 0
  hasSpanMatch: true
  args:
    @akey_0 = string "a"
    @aval_0 = float64 3
    @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T04:06:40Z
    @environments = []string []string{"prod"}
    @excServices = []string []string{"noisy"}
    @excStatuses = []string []string{"STATUS_CODE_OK"}
    @httpMethods = []string []string{"GET"}
    @httpStatuses = []string []string{"500"}

=== metrics/tag/mixed
  resourceWhere: AND service IN @services AND service NOT IN @excServices
  attrWhere: AND attributes['custom.one'] = @mf0 AND attributes['custom.two'] IN @mf1
  args:
    @excServices = []string []string{"b"}
    @mf0 = string "x"
    @mf1 = []string []string{"y", "z"}
    @services = []string []string{"a"}

=== metrics/selection/groupByResource/step=auto
  fromTable: optikk.metrics_1m
  cte: WITH fps AS ( SELECT fingerprint, service AS g0 FROM optikk.metrics_series PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND metric_name = @metricName AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end GROUP BY fingerprint, g0 )
  joins: INNER JOIN fps ON m.fingerprint = fps.fingerprint
  selectCols: toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) AS bucket_at, [toString(fps.g0)] AS group_values
  groupByCols: bucket_at, fps.g0
  args:

=== metrics/tagValueArms
  arm[0]: SELECT @k0 AS tag_key, service AS tag_value, count() AS c FROM optikk.metrics_series PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND metric_name = @metricName WHERE service != '' GROUP BY tag_value
  arm[1]: SELECT @k1 AS tag_key, attributes['custom.tag'] AS tag_value, count() AS c FROM optikk.metrics_series PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND metric_name = @metricName WHERE attributes['custom.tag'] != '' GROUP BY tag_value
  args:
    @k0 = string "service"
    @k1 = string "custom.tag"
